why_it_works.text: 26 days live — past the two-week test window
Delivering on 4 placements — broad budget, likely Advantage+
'Shop now' is a closing CTA — bottom of funnel
3-card carousel — letting Meta pick the winner
3 creative assets in one ad — they are testing variations

watch_outs: Body copy only 17 chars — thin on context
Opening line has no number, price or question to grab on

steal: Build 3 creative variants and let Meta allocate, the way they are
They use 'Shop now' — closing straight from the feed, no warm-up step
Placements are wide open, not hand-picked — budget is going through Advantage+
Page has 482,964 followers — brand recall is doing part of the work, expect weaker numbers cold
